rules.title: Cleartext HTTP URL
rules.remediation: Use HTTPS or an explicitly justified secure local endpoint.

rules.title: Potential hardcoded secret
rules.remediation: Move secrets to a secure runtime mechanism and rotate exposed credentials.

rules.title: Logging call requires review
rules.remediation: Remove sensitive or noisy logs before release, or gate them behind a debug build.

rules.title: Potential unused local variable
rules.message: `{name}` is assigned but is not referenced later in this file.
rules.remediation: Remove it, use it, or suppress this finding when a framework accesses it indirectly.

rules.title: Exposed mutable Kotlin property
rules.message: A mutable property has no private visibility modifier.
rules.remediation: Prefer private state with an immutable public view.

rules.title: WebView JavaScript enabled
rules.message: JavaScript execution increases WebView attack surface.
rules.remediation: Enable it only for trusted content and restrict navigation and bridges.

rules.title: Custom TLS validation requires review
rules.message: Custom certificate or hostname validation can disable TLS protections.
rules.remediation: Use platform TLS validation unless a documented pinning design requires customization.

rules.title: Debuggable application
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Confirm the release merged manifest sets android:debuggable to false.

rules.title: Cleartext traffic opt-in
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Review network security configuration and disable unnecessary cleartext traffic.

rules.title: Test-only application
rules.message: Application declares android:{attribute}=true; review the intended build variant.
rules.remediation: Remove android:testOnly from production manifests; keep it only in test builds.
